Our data science team has been iterating on a telecom customer churn prediction model in a Jupyter notebook (located in the notebooks/ folder of this project). Leadership has approved moving this to production, and our MLOps pipeline requires a proper, installable Python package.

Please industrialize this prototype into a distributable package called `churn_predictor`. The package needs to be set up so that engineers can install it and run a training command simply by typing `train` in the terminal.

The existing workspace already has some helper tooling in the `scripts/` directory. The final package code should live under `src/`, and the project's `pyproject.toml` (already present at the root) must be updated to expose the training CLI command.

The internal code should be cleanly separated: data-loading and model-saving logic must be isolated from the pure mathematical/feature-engineering logic, and a separate orchestration layer should wire everything together and expose the `main` entry point for the CLI.
